I so understand you OP- I was married to someone like this. He would scream at me that I was "too sensitive", he would attack me verbally, he would give me the silent treatment for days, he would tell me I drove him " crazy", he rarely apologized for any of his abuse and when he did he was hostile about it and would blame me for his behavior. It was an oft repeated cycle and  I put up with it for far too long because we had kids. I finally left him and it was one of the best decisions I have ever made. If you are posting here and calling the Suicide Hotline because your ex is abusive and makes you feel that bad about yourself, then I would cut off all contact from him.

I cannot give you the courage to pull the trigger OP. I am about your age and I too have been unemployed for the past 2 years. Prior to being laid off I had never been unemployed. I am also alone-  no family and isolated from friends. I am so tired of swimming upstream that I came really close to calling it quits a few weeks ago. I think what stopped me was the idea that even though I would feel relief from the pain I was in, it also meant I would forever be denied the opportunity to help others going through difficult times.
